candidates.name: short
candidates.clm_description: set the next target position to -1

candidates.name: flat
candidates.clm_description: set the next target position to 0

candidates.name: long
candidates.clm_description: set the next target position to +1

action_semantics.reason: The environment action selects a target position, not an order instruction.

agent_state_v1.matching_rule: Add identical normalized fields to feed-forward and recurrent controls.

training_target_options.meaning: Train the three cosine logits through the existing PPO objective without inventing oracle labels.
Copy a frozen solver and claim only compression or teacher generalization.
Use future outcomes only in labels under an explicit horizon, cost, tie, and abstention rule; policy inputs remain causal.

loss_guardrail: Do not use naive single-positive pairwise InfoNCE with repeated short, flat, and long action labels. Use per-question choice softmax, a multi-positive loss, or PPO.
calibration_guardrail: A cosine softmax or CLM candidate probability is not expected net utility or trading confidence until calibrated on held-out chronological data.
